name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-05-30, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.37 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
